answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded lantern that changes every epoch. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its yarrow from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. The tundra is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal 1ndt6.
